'''Milton''' (Japanese: '''ハワード''' ''Howard'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP159|A Dairy Tale Ending]]''. He is the uncle of {{ci|Goldenrod}} [[Gym Leader]] [[Whitney]].

Milton runs a {{p|Miltank}} dairy on the outskirts of Goldenrod City, which Whitney thinks is the greatest. On the dairy, he milks and takes care of his Miltank, as well as making his own dairy products, such as cheese and yogurt. Although Ash had a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} with his niece before and lost, he battled her again, this time unofficially, on Milton's farm. While Ash used three Pokémon, Whitney only used her own Miltank. This time, Ash managed to win. Although Ash was not sure if he won fair and square, Milton stated to Ash that he believes that the most important aspect of winning a [[Badge]] is beating the [[Gym Leader]]'s top Pokémon. Whitney then gave Ash the {{Badge|Plain}}.

His farm is based on the in-game [[Moomoo Farm]], despite being located near Goldenrod City instead of on {{rt|39|Johto}}.
